servers.name: IPinfo All Tools
servers.description: All available IPinfo MCP tools: ipinfo_lookup, ipinfo_geolocate, ipinfo_asn, ipinfo_check_privacy, ipinfo_check_residential_proxy, and ipinfo_quota.

servers.name: IPinfo Lookup
servers.description: Look up geolocation, network, and metadata for one or more IP addresses (lite and detailed modes supported).

servers.name: IPinfo Geolocate
servers.description: Get geographic location data (country, continent, city, region, coordinates, timezone, postal code) for IP addresses.

servers.name: IPinfo ASN
servers.description: Get autonomous system (network ownership) information for IP addresses: ASN, name, domain, and network type.

servers.name: IPinfo Privacy Check
servers.description: Check whether IP addresses are using privacy or anonymity services: VPN, proxy, relay, Tor, anycast, hosting, mobile, or satellite.

servers.name: IPinfo Residential Proxy Check
servers.description: Check whether IP addresses are known residential proxies, returning service name, last seen date, and observation frequency.

servers.name: IPinfo Quota Check
servers.description: Check your IPinfo API usage and remaining quota (daily and monthly request counts and plan limit).
